title: Homology with constant differential ranks on a reduced scheme
statement: Let Y be a reduced scheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme], P a cochain complex of modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and choose bases P^n ≅ O_Y^{r(n)} [def-weil-pbc-free-module] for every n ∈ Z. Fix q ∈ Z, an open immersion j:Z→Y [def-weil-open-immersion], and natural numbers a,b. Let A and B be the matrices of d^q and d^{q-1} in these bases. Suppose that for every z∈Z there is a field R and a morphism g:Spec R→Y with image exactly {j(z)} for which rank(A(g))=a and rank(B(g))=b [def-weil-matrix-rank]. Then H^q(j^*P) is finite locally free of rank r(q)-a-b [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], with natural subtraction. Neither boundedness of P nor a proper morphism producing P is required.

proof.text: For the complex of finite free sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], restrict to affine neighbourhoods in the open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion]. A field-valued point with singleton image induces an extension of the residue field. By [lem-weil-matrix-rank-field-extension], the two given ranks a and b are the residue-field ranks at every point.

The affine rings of the open subscheme are reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. All (a+1)-minors of the outgoing matrix and (b+1)-minors of the incoming matrix vanish in every residue field, hence lie in every prime and in the nilradical, and are zero. At a point choose nonzero maximal minors and invert their product. The size-zero minor is 1. Invertible row and column operations put each matrix in the form diag(I,S), with S its Schur complement. Every entry of S is a larger minor divided by the invertible maximal minor, so S=0. The two differentials may use different bases.

On these neighbourhoods the outgoing kernel Z is free of rank r(q)-a and the incoming image B is free of rank b, each a direct summand of the middle free term [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. The complex identity gives B contained in Z. Restrict a retraction of the middle term onto B to Z, making Z/B finite projective of rank r(q)-a-b. The rank inequality a+b <= r(q) holds over the residue fields. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-standard-free-cover] to obtain local free trivializations of the quotient.

Open pullback is restriction [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-module-pullback-restriction] and is exact, as is affine sheafification. Thus the quotient Z/B is the homology of the pulled-back complex. The local trivializations give finite local freeness of the claimed constant rank [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Empty opens require no neighbourhood; zero ranks are covered by the empty-minor case.

lean.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_homology_pullback_of_constantRank
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] {P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ} {r : ℤ → ℕ}
    (e : ∀ n, P.X n ≅ free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (r n))))
    (q : ℤ) (j : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] (a b : ℕ)
    (hrank : ∀ z : Z, ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsField R) (g : Spec R ⟶ Y),
      Set.range g.base = {j.base z} ∧
      ((freeMatrix ((e q).inv ≫ P.d q (q + 1) ≫ (e (q + 1)).hom)).map g.appTop).rank = a ∧
      ((freeMatrix ((e (q - 1)).inv ≫ P.d (q - 1) q ≫ (e q).hom)).map g.appTop).rank = b) :
    ((((Modules.pullback j).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P).homology q).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
       (r q - a - b)
